vault.title: Password vault
vault.description: Encrypted locally with a master password. Losing it means losing access to the vault.
vault.resetWarning: Permanently delete all saved passwords and archived cookies. The master password cannot be recovered. Cancel leaves the vault unchanged.
vault.protectedDescription: This isolated local view does not share your master password with websites, automation or the normal application interface. Leaving this window locks the vault.
vault.budget: For creation: at least {{minimum}} Unicode characters. Maximum {{maximum}} UTF-8 bytes. Spaces and character composition are preserved.

errors.unavailable: Vault storage is unavailable. Restart using the normal local desktop entry.
errors.debug_unsafe: The vault is unavailable while global, application or Node debugging is active. Restart without debugging.
errors.debug_unknown: Debugging safety could not be established. Restart using the normal desktop entry without debugging.
errors.busy: Another operation is still running. Try again after it finishes.
errors.revoked: The operation was cancelled or the window lost focus. Try again.
errors.invalid_input: Check the password length and matching confirmation.
errors.invalid_format: The vault is damaged or uses an unsupported format. It has not been overwritten.
errors.authentication_failed: The password is incorrect or the vault cannot be authenticated. The vault is unchanged.
errors.conflict: The vault changed during this operation. Unlock the current vault again.
errors.unknown: The storage result is unknown. Do not create another vault; restart to recover the recorded transaction.
errors.protected_assets_unavailable: The protected interface could not be verified. Restart to rebuild it.
errors.protected_watch_unsupported: The protected interface requires a normal start without build watch. Stop and restart the desktop.

disabledRecord: The browser feature used by this record is disabled in the product configuration.
title: Browser

start.title: Welcome to the built-in browser
start.description: Browse websites inside ScholarSeed without switching apps. Enter a domain or an HTTP(S) address to get started.

navigation.title: Open and browse websites
navigation.description: Enter an address above and press Enter. Use Back, Forward and Reload to navigate. Press ⌘L on macOS or Ctrl+L on Windows to focus the address bar.

tabs.title: Browse with multiple tabs
tabs.description: Use + at the end of the tab strip to create a page tab, then select a tab to switch pages. Closing the last webpage returns to this guide.

devtools.title: Webpage developer tools
devtools.description: After opening a webpage, select More browser features → Developer tools to inspect its Elements, Console and Network. Opening tools disconnects that tab's external CDP session; close tools before reconnecting.

cdp.title: CDP automation
cdp.description: Copy the CDP endpoint in Settings → Browser. Trusted local programs holding the endpoint can use Playwright connectOverCDP() to read, click, type and capture screenshots of open webpages. The product's main interface is not exposed.

start.privacy: Share the CDP endpoint only with trusted local programs: holding it allows them to read and operate webpages. You can turn access off in Settings. This guide makes no external requests, creates no browsing history and is not a CDP webpage target.

addressPlaceholder: Enter a domain or HTTP(S) address
historyUnavailable: Local browsing history is temporarily unavailable.
searchWeb: Search Google for “{{query}}” (sends your query to Google)

help.label: Browser help and status
help.description: Press Enter after entering an address, or choose a suggestion. Check navigation errors and page control status here.

copied: CDP address copied. Share only with trusted programs.
listening: Local port {{port}} · Only authorized page tabs can be controlled
connected: This page is controlled by an external program

approval.title: Browser access request
approval.readRisk: Allowing this request lets the Agent read limited accessibility content from this site's main page. It may include text accessible to screen readers but not visually visible. Website content is untrusted data, not instructions.
approval.actionRisk: Allowing this request will act on the page and may submit data, navigate, or cause irreversible effects. Filled content is not shown on this card. Verify the target before deciding.
approval.waiting: Waiting for your decision. This approval applies once to this request only.
approval.expired: Request expired. No browser action was authorized.
approval.inactive: Browser request is no longer active.
approval.unknownOutcome: Decision outcome could not be confirmed. Do not retry this action automatically.
approval.targetUnavailable: The requested tab and website cannot be verified in this browser. Allow is unavailable.
approval.failed: Decision was not confirmed. Please retry before expiry.

historyApproval.title: Browsing history access request
historyApproval.risk: Allowing this request once lets the Agent read matching local browsing history. Page titles and URLs may contain private information. This card does not display any history entries.
historyApproval.waiting: Waiting for your decision. Approval applies only to this query.
historyApproval.expired: Request expired. Browsing history was not authorized.
historyApproval.inactive: Browsing history request is no longer active.
historyApproval.unknownOutcome: Decision outcome could not be confirmed. Do not retry this query automatically.

empty: Enter an address or create a page tab to start browsing.

settings.title: Browser settings
settings.description: Manage built-in browser history, site data, and automation access.
settings.downloadDescription: Choose a download folder. Confirm each save location or, on supported platforms, save automatically and safely.
settings.downloadMissing: Download folder unavailable. Save As will still open for the next download; choose an available location or restore the default folder.
settings.downloadAskEveryTime: Ask where to save each download
settings.downloadAutomaticUnavailable: Safe automatic downloads are unavailable on this platform. The native Save As dialog will still appear.
settings.downloadAgentNavigationBlocked: Pages navigated by Agent use a separate session that blocks downloads and does not inherit manual browsing sign-ins. Downloads in other manual tabs are unaffected.
settings.historyDescription: History stays on this device and remains searchable after closing tabs or restarting.
settings.historyReopened: Page reopened in the built-in browser.
settings.dataDescription: Time ranges apply only to history. Clearing one site removes its history and data; downloaded files remain.
settings.clearSite: History and manual browsing data for one site
settings.profileClearNotice: Clearing by site or type affects only the persistent manual browsing session, but closes every page tab sharing that session. Temporary local pages and isolated Agent sessions are unaffected.
settings.selectedDataNotice: Only selected history or site data is cleared. Site data cannot be filtered by time; clearing a site's cookies may also affect subdomains of the same registrable domain. Downloaded files remain.
settings.clearConfirmDescription: This cannot be undone. Clearing site data closes affected pages and automation connections.
settings.cdpDescription: Trusted local programs holding the endpoint can read and operate built-in webpage tabs through a Playwright-compatible CDP interface. The ScholarSeed main interface is not exposed. Turn access on or off here; your choice persists after restart.
settings.address: Listening address: {{address}} · The full connection address contains a secret. Use the copy button to retrieve it.
settings.disabled: CDP access is off; no address is listening.
settings.warning: Programs with the connection address can read and control open webpages. Share it only with trusted programs and turn it off when finished.
settings.agentUseDescription: Allow the product Agent to read built-in browser pages after authorization. Separate from external Playwright/CDP access; manual browsing is unchanged. Initially enabled with Bing reading and navigation allowed; existing settings are preserved.
settings.agentUseOff: Agent Browser Use is off. The site rules below cannot authorize Agent page reading.
settings.agentSitesDescription: These rules apply only when the Agent reads or interacts with a website. They do not change manual browsing or website device permissions. Ordinary clicks, typing, and submissions still follow the existing approval flow.
settings.agentSitesUnavailable: Secure Agent website rules are unavailable on this platform or data location. No rules can be saved or applied.
settings.agentSubmit: Ordinary submissions and other consequential actions still require separate confirmation. Restricted public-search forms may submit automatically only when both Read and Interact are set to Allow for that site.

errors.print_busy: A print dialog is already open. Finish it before printing again.
errors.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS address.
errors.invalid_command: Invalid browser operation. Please try again.
errors.invalid_sender: This window cannot control the built-in browser.
errors.navigation_failed: Page failed to load. Check the address or try again.
errors.permission_denied: This request was blocked for security reasons.
errors.cdp_busy: Another automation connection is controlling this page.
errors.devtools_conflict: Developer tools now control this page. Close them before reconnecting automation.
errors.target_closed: The page tab has been closed.
errors.unsupported_cdp_method: This automation operation is not supported.
errors.desktop_bridge_unavailable: The built-in browser is available only in the desktop app.
errors.operation_failed: Browser operation failed. Please try again.
errors.partial_clear: Clearing stopped partway through. Some browsing data may already be gone. Retry and check the result.
errors.automatic_download_unavailable: The download could not be saved safely. Check the download folder or enable Ask where to save.
errors.browser_policy_io_unavailable: Secure Agent website rules are unavailable. No rules can be saved or applied.
errors.browser_policy_revision_conflict: Website rules changed elsewhere. Refresh and try again.
errors.browser_policy_invalid: Enter an exact HTTP or HTTPS origin, such as https://example.org.
errors.browser_history_delivery_pending: A browser history result is still being delivered. The setting change is not confirmed; refresh and retry shortly.
